Modifications: Oak’s model was deduplicated, its legacy diffuse materials converted, and sleeves and hands lowered in a separate baked pose. No authored skeleton, voice or character animation was supplied. Procedural presentation and laboratory placement are separate application work.

Poké Ball variants have baked transforms and normalized placement. Same-material surfaces were merged, dense surfaces selectively simplified and constant source colours retained through lossless reduction or vertex colours. Source gloss and emission were adapted for the garden.

These credits preserve declared model licenses and modifications. Pokémon characters and names remain third-party intellectual property; no independent franchise permission or official affiliation is asserted.
